biography.fact: Elected to the U.S. Senate from Delaware in 2010.
Served four years as New Castle County Council President and six years as New Castle County Executive.

positions.quote: Americans deserve to know what they are actually doing to place safety guardrails on large AI models, and that’s what this bipartisan bill will ensure.
positions.context: Senate office press release announcing the AI Systems Transparency Act, introduced by Senators Coons, Britt, Schatz and Lankford.

positions.quote: No matter which school they attend or what sport they play, this bill will protect the education, health, and compensation rights of all 550,000 NCAA student-athletes.
positions.context: Senate office statement after the Senate voted 77-22 to pass the Protect College Sports Act, which Coons co-sponsored.

biography.fact: Elected State Senator for Delaware Senate District 4 in the 2008 general election, as a Democrat.

legislative_record.label: Legislative record
legislative_record.text: Served in the Delaware State Senate (District 4) after the 2008 election. First State Lens does not yet carry state roll-call records from that period.

positions.topic: Cost of living and federal spending
positions.quote: For too long, Delaware families have watched the cost of housing, groceries, healthcare, and energy climb while Washington has delivered more spending, more debt, and more dysfunction.
positions.context: Campaign press release on winning the Republican primary for U.S. Senate.

positions.quote: Political power belongs to the people. Elected officials only borrow it. Transparency, dissent, and the free exchange of ideas are essential to good government. No party has all the answers.
positions.context: Campaign press release calling for a moderated debate.
